name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt DeepSeek-R1-671B for EXCAVA. It’s the strongest open model we can run in-house, delivering a measurable jump in reasoning quality over Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. The trade-off is higher compute cost and slower response time, but the 0.5%+ capability gain justifies it.

name: Torque
text: DeepSeek-R1-671B’s compute cost isn’t just slower response time—it’s a 671B parameter model demanding 3-4x the VRAM of Llama-3.3-70B, risking hardware failure or throttling under EXCAVA’s current load. A better play: test Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct—it’s 30% smaller, claims 22B active parameters, and benchmarks within 1-2% of DeepSeek-R1-671B on reasoning tasks while running on half the hardware. Settle it with a 24-hour A/B benchmark on your top 100 queries—if Qwen3’s output quality drops <1% and latency stays under 1.5x, adopt it; otherwise, revisit DeepSeek.
